gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Flat-lined and open-shaped, Bellota Text stands out with a fineliner's plain stroke, while ZCOOL XiaoWei underneath carries a faintly modulated, steady line. Down a full page, the sans-serif body keeps moving without a snag.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-hind: Ruler-drawn, constant-width lines give Bruno Ace its whole, unmistakable character. It does its best work big and brief, while Hind supplies sans-serif text whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alan-sans: Wire-smooth and unmistakable, Bruno Ace glides along with open counters, while Alan Sans holds its curve tails well back from the body. One draws the eye, the other lets it settle.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alef: Machined and unmistakable: Bruno Ace has no stress in any curve, just a ruler-drawn line. Alef then carries the text with open-ended curves that let paragraphs flow without fuss.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Expressive is the word for Bruno Ace, with strokes that never thin out. That stroke is built for making a statement, whereas Alegreya Sans SC is built for steady reading, its c opening up in welcome.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-anta: Distinctive from the first letter, Bruno Ace lingers with one character per beat. Anta, with its wire-bent sign look, is approachable, so Bruno Ace can stay big and brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-bpmf-huninn: Bruno Ace lingers on each character, its ruler-drawn line leaving every counter firmly connected to the outside. Bpmf Huninn is the quieter one, with a single-weight outline feel throughout.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-cairo: Bruno Ace has round letters whose rims match the stems, a ruler-drawn line with a lingering beat. And Cairo, with a wide channel into every bowl, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-catamaran: Catamaran is all loose, curvy letters that feel unclamped. Next to Bruno Ace, whose outlines never swell and whose lines look ruler-drawn, that looseness loosens up the whole layout.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Expressive through and through, Bruno Ace builds n arches that match the stems beside them. But Chiron Hei HK wins on openness, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart.
